name: Finale Garden
source:
Someday, the world will come to its finale.

Year 20X2. 
A mysterious 'BUG' appeared and the world turned cold.
And then, as if cursed, the world came to an end...

High schoolers "RAIN" and "STAR” settled themselves in an abandoned greenhouse.
As the last people in the world, they see themselves to their finale with…
